effects.effect: Your stone skin affords you potent protection. You have a +6 [bonus](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bonuses-and-penalties) to [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina), and that [bonus](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bonuses-and-penalties) increases by 6 at 4th, 7th, and 10th levels.
